UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile with isolated personal information.

uid.description: Firebase Auth user UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name shown in Workspace OS.

photoURL.description: Optional user profile avatar URL or empty string.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

WorkspaceStoreEntry.title: WorkspaceStoreEntry
WorkspaceStoreEntry.description: Per-user persisted state slice for a Workspace OS module (emails, drive, tasks, calendar, notes, etc.).

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this workspace data slice.

storeKey.description: Identifier of the persisted store matching the document ID.

items.description: Optional bounded list of structured workspace items (max 250).

record.description: Optional structured map for key-value workspace state (max 100 keys).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the store entry was first persisted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest store update.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile document accessible exclusively by its authenticated owner.

/users/{userId}/workspace/{storeKey}.description: Per-user Workspace OS persisted module collections isolated by userId.
